=== DOCS-TRUTH VERIFIED (2026-06-08 via WebFetch trino.io/docs/467/functions/{map,json,conditional,math,comparison,aggregate}.html) ===

• map_agg(key, value) → map<K,V>; multimap_agg(key, value) → map<K,array(V)>; map() empty; map(array(K), array(V)) → map(K,V) two-arg constructor.
• element_at(map(K,V), key) → V returns NULL if key not present in the map; subscript map[key] throws an error if the key is not contained in the map (strict).
• map_keys(map(K,V)) → array(K); map_values(map(K,V)) → array(V).
• json_extract(json, json_path) → json; json_extract_scalar(json, json_path) → varchar; json_array_length(json) → bigint (takes the array itself NOT a path); json_parse(varchar) → json.
• json_query / json_value / json_exists ARE in Trino 467 (SQL/JSON standard). json_value accepts RETURNING type + ON EMPTY/ERROR; json_query accepts RETURNING type + WITH/WITHOUT ARRAY WRAPPER + KEEP/OMIT QUOTES + ON EMPTY/ERROR; json_exists accepts {TRUE|FALSE|UNKNOWN|ERROR} ON ERROR.
• try(expression) — evaluates expression and returns NULL on division by zero / invalid cast or function argument / numeric value out of range. Companion try_cast(x AS type) is cast-only.
• greatest(v1,...,vN) / least(v1,...,vN) — SCALAR multi-arg row-wise. Return NULL if ANY argument is NULL (matches Oracle/MySQL/BigQuery; PostgreSQL is the outlier — ignores NULLs).
• width_bucket BOTH overloads exist: 4-arg equal-width width_bucket(x, bound1, bound2, n) and array overload width_bucket(x, bins) where bins is ascending DOUBLE array. Both → bigint.
• approx_distinct(x) → bigint; approx_distinct(x, e) → bigint with e in [0.0040625, 0.26000]. 'Zero is returned if all input values are null.'
